detail.longDescription: I'm new here, hello! 👋 I'm learning how to # code through # 100DaysOfSwiftUI via @ twostraws . As I progress, I'm taking notes and hosting all my learnings to # GitHub in a repository with an interactive readme table of contents, both for my own reference and to help others. My goal is to make a whimsical # ttrpg - inspired to-do list / habit tracker w/ combat, loot, classes, and more. I look forward to building a # community here! # indiedev # appdev # opensource # solorpg # noai # coding
